decision: Does TensorLBM's per-face selective (lbmpy/waLBerla PackInfo-derived) ghost exchange reproduce the monolithic D3Q19 solution exactly and reproduce the OSS implementation's communication-volume reduction, and does the physical anchor of that claim (3D Taylor-Green vortex against the Stokes solution) pass the owner 15 % band once the reference exponent is corrected?

alternatives.A_serial: monolithic single-buffer D3Q19 pull stream over the whole (19,n,n,n) lattice, fully periodic (torch.roll) -- physical reference and identity reference
alternatives.A_ship: shipped tensorlbm.multi_gpu.D3Q19GlooTransport: 19-population boundary planes per face, fresh padded buffer per step
alternatives.A_ship_persistent: A_ship with a preallocated padded buffer
alternatives.A_fused: lbmpy/waLBerla PackInfo transplant: only the x-crossing populations (5 of 19 per face for D3Q19) are packed, exchanged and unpacked into the ghost plane
alternatives.A_fused_persistent: A_fused with the persistent padded buffer
alternatives.A_product: the shipped class itself with selective_ghosts=True -- the L3 integration arm (R1 had no product path at all)
alternatives.A_no_arm: do nothing: keep the R1 report (formula 2*nu*k^2, 1 of 4 configs delivered, no product integration) -- rejected by the m18155 audit findings 1-4

hypothesis.H1_identity: every decomposed arm, including the product path, reproduces the monolithic field bit-exactly (max|df| == 0.0) in float32 and float64
hypothesis.H2_bytes: the selective exchange moves exactly n_cross/Q = 5/19 of the shipped wire bytes per step
hypothesis.H3_anchor: with the corrected 3D Stokes exponent (3 nu k^2 for the velocity amplitude, not the 2D 2 nu k^2) the TGV relative L2 error falls inside the owner 15 % band
hypothesis.H4_regime: the residual error of the corrected anchor is dominated by the O(U0^2) nonlinearity of the real TGV, not by the transport: it must shrink monotonically along the predeclared U0 ladder 0.04 -> 0.01 -> 0.0025 (dissipation-scale Reynolds number U0/(nu k) = 8.2 -> 2.0 -> 0.51)
hypothesis.H5_rate: the measured kinetic-energy decay rate equals nu * |3 k^2| within 5 % in the linear regime, which pins the viscosity through the whole transport chain
falsifiers: H1 fails on any nonzero bit difference
H2 fails if the byte ratio differs from 5/19
H4 fails if the error does not decrease monotonically along the U0 ladder

metrics.tgv_rel_l2: ||u_num - u_analytic||_2 / ||u_analytic||_2 over the three velocity components at t_end, against the corrected 3D Stokes mode
metrics.fitted_decay_rate: -ln(||u(t)||/||u(0)||)/t; compare with analytic rate nu * 6 (1 - cos k) (lattice) resp. 3 nu k^2 (continuum)
metrics.identity_max_abs: max|f_arm - f_serial| over the assembled field; exact zero expected
metrics.wire_bytes_per_step: sum of numel*element_size over the two send and two receive buffers of one step (both directions)
metrics.step_ms / exchange_ms / mlups: wall time per step, of the exchange alone, and mega lattice-site updates per second

unit_of_analysis: one completed run (arm x grid x rank count x dtype x tau x U0 x step count)

baseline_control.physical_baseline: corrected Stokes solution of the 3D single-mode TGV: u = U0 sin(kx) cos(ky) cos(kz) e^{-nu*3k^2*t}, v = -U0 cos(kx) sin(ky) cos(kz) e^{-nu*3k^2*t}, w = 0, k = 2 pi/n (lattice eigenvalue 6(1-cos k) used for the fitted-rate comparison)
baseline_control.identity_baseline: A_serial field after the same number of steps with the same collision
baseline_control.representation_control: A_ship vs A_fused: collision, streaming, geometry, dtype, tau, U0 and step count identical; the only changed variable is the packed population set (plus the buffer-allocation factor)
baseline_control.oss_control: the crossing-population set is machine-compared against lbmpy's own _extend_dir (tests/test_xval_mpi_ghost_fused.py::test_crossing_populations_match_oss_extend_dir), never against a hand-written table
baseline_control.r1_control: the R1 delivered numbers (24.887 % at n64_r2 with the 2 nu k^2 reference) are reproduced and attributed as a reference defect, not re-tuned away

predeclared_thresholds.interpretation: the 15 % band is the owner physics band and applies to tgv_rel_l2; identity is exact-zero because a data-movement change has no legitimate numerical freedom; the byte ratio has no tolerance because it is an integer count; the 5 % band on the fitted decay rate is the audit's remediation-3 regression tolerance
predeclared_thresholds.regime_declaration: the linear Stokes anchor is declared valid for U0/(nu k) <= 2.1 (the 0.01 rung); the 0.04 rung is retained only as the R1 continuity point and is explicitly labelled nonlinear-regime
predeclared_thresholds.stopping_rule: every configuration runs its predeclared step count and stops early only on non-finite state, rho outside [0.9,1.1] or Ma = U0 sqrt(3) > 0.2; no arm is extended or re-tuned after KPIs are seen. Wall budget 1200 s per configuration; anything above that is moved to the cluster queue (all R2 runs are submitted there).
predeclared_thresholds.convergence_rule: n=32 vs n=64 at fixed rank count and U0, plus the discrete-vs-continuum eigenvalue gap k^2/12 (0.08 % at n=64, 0.32 % at n=32) reported as a reference-discretisation term
predeclared_thresholds.sensitivity_rule: two predeclared sensitivity axes: rank count 2 -> 4 at fixed n=64 (comm surface grows, global work fixed) and tau 0.65 -> 0.60 at fixed n=32, U0=0.01 (viscosity/dissipation path); the U0 ladder is the third axis and the anchor-regime argument

deviations_from_r1: reference exponent 2 nu k^2 -> nu * |lap eigenvalue| (= 3 nu k^2 continuum, 6(1-cos k) lattice): audit finding 3
4 of 4 previously declared configs delivered, not 1 of 4: audit finding 4
a product-path arm (D3Q19GlooTransport(selective_ghosts=True)) exists and is measured: audit finding 2
U0 ladder added so the anchor's linear-regime validity is demonstrated instead of asserted
fitted decay rate reported as an independent (anchor-free) viscosity check: audit remediation 3

environment.compute: cluster queue job, node assigned by the scheduler (no node pinning), one gloo process per rank on the node
